name: Cutting Teeth
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The first order of business will be to put a little strength in your backbone. I could send you out to the Barrens to hunt kodo, but well, in all honesty, you're more useful to us alive than dead.

I believe you would find a good match with the mottled boars you'll find to the north of here.
narrative.objectives: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hmmm, not bad, adventurer. But don't let it get to your head...you'll fight tougher than boars in your career.

Nonetheless, you've proven yourself well, and your next trial will be against a considerably more dangerous opponent, so you'll need some extra protection.
narrative.requestItemsText: I hope you haven't returned to try and convince me that you have completed your task, adventurer? No, of course not. I would think better of you.

chain.subtitle: 16 quests from level 1 to 3, 920 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: One quest for each class
quests.objectiveText: Warrior, Warrior, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Priest, Mage, Hunter, Rogue, Shaman, Warlock

quests.name: Sting of the Scorpid
quests.objectiveText: Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.
